tools.name: pin_toolprint
tools.description: Pin the reference print of an MCP tool's definition as presented to you: server (the server's endpoint URL, or a provider-chosen URN for a local server), tool name, and the definition (description, input_schema, terms where present). The pin is signed: sign the JCS-canonical bytes of {"action": "too

tools.name: check_toolprint
tools.description: Check a tool's definition as presented in your current session against the print on record. Returns match, changed (with the fields that differ — values for text fields, digests for the schema), or unknown (no print on record; the response carries the current digest so the definition can be pinned).

tools.name: toolprint_history
tools.description: Every distinct print on record for a (server, tool) pair, in first-seen order: digest, tier, pinned by/at, first and last seen, observation count, the field digests, and the full pinned definition — plus the change events: each moment a new distinct digest was first observed for the pair. Read-only;
